svg.text: regulatorPololu D36V50F5 5 V 5.5 A step-down regulator
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
VBAT 14.8 V from F1: load 24.485 A typical, 96.485 A peak; source 60 A cont, 120 A peak; fuse 50 A
5V 5 V from U8: load 1.221 A typical, 3.035 A peak; source 5 A cont, 5 A peak
Fuses: F1 50 A (everything on VBAT), F2 2 A (branch regulator), F3 15 A (branch esc_1), F4 15 A (branch esc_2), F5 15 A (branch esc_3), F6 15 A (branch
esc_4). Branch fuses sit inline in the lead they protect.
Lever splices (star_ground, splice_vbat, splice_5v) are junctions of their nets.
Same net label or power symbol = same conductor. X = pin not connected.
